name: cn.jesse.magicbox.view.activity.MagicBoxActivity
description: Magic-Box (HiJesse developer toolkit) opens a diagnostics dashboard when the app requests it. The dashboard controls CPU, memory, and frame-rate monitoring, request logging, and tests that simulate blocked, slow, or timed-out network access.
disableEffect: The developer dashboard and its monitoring and network simulation controls will be unavailable; regular app screens remain available.
